terms.comment: Queried by Morgan–Owens. Traupman 355 gives encombōma for overalls, but Lewis & Short defines it as a white garment worn by girls (Varr.).

sources: Lewis & Short: encomboma
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. overalls. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers), p. 355.
